cases.title: Evaluate the coefficient sum with its scale
cases.spot: Asked for a sum of coefficients rather than each coefficient.
cases.hand: Evaluate at 1; multiply by 6 for efc469c4 because coefficients were divided by 6.
cases.calculator: Enter the original expression at 1; preserve outside scale.

cases.title: Cancel structure before expanding
cases.spot: Shared blocks, a perfect square, signed products, or a geometric sum.
cases.hand: Subtract shared a first; recognize (c+d)²; distribute signed factors; telescope powers.
cases.calculator: A numeric substitution can reject choices; it does not establish an identity.

cases.title: Use a known factor as a zero
cases.spot: A linear factor is given and a parameter is requested.
cases.hand: Substitute x=k into the first polynomial. For the second, use (3x+7)(x+2b).
cases.calculator: Evaluate the polynomial at the stated factor root, retaining k>0 or integral b>0.

cases.title: Tangency belongs to the difference
cases.spot: A parabola and an oblique line intersect exactly once.
cases.hand: Subtract equations; repeated zero of 2x²-24x+64-a gives x=6.
cases.calculator: Graph both equations only after finding a=-8; inspect the common point.
cases.check: At x=6 both y values are 10. This is not the original parabola vertex.

cases.title: Strict discriminant bounds and integers
cases.spot: No real solution plus an integer extremum.
cases.hand: Set discriminant strictly below zero and then select an allowed integer.
cases.calculator: Use a calculator for the real bound, then check neighboring integers algebraically.
cases.check: 16, 51, 50, 14; equality would give one real solution. No live calculator execution claimed.

cases.title: Count exponential crossings by range
cases.spot: An increasing exponential minus a positive constant.
cases.hand: Base a/7>1 gives strict increase, and the range after subtracting b is (-b,infinity); zero occurs once.
cases.calculator: A graph at sample constants can illustrate the result; monotonicity and range prove it for every allowed constant.
cases.check: One crossing. a>7 and b>0 suffice; b>c is not needed.
